views.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create detailed natural 16:9 watercolor game background preview for The Grand Tour scene24 PREAH KO / 神牛寺, frontal brick sanctuary group. Reference1 APSARA National Authority official original https://apsaraauthority.gov.kh/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/APSARA-Authority_Angkor-Temple_Preah-Ko-Temple_Angkor-Temple_Siem-Reap.jpg-17.jpg is SOLE architecture, sculpture, viewpoint and condition source. Reference2 approved Thommanon watercolor is STYLE ONLY, no architecture transfer. Faithfully render this photographed frontal view with THREE large front brick towers and only actually visible portions of rear sanctuaries behind them. Central tall tower has stepped brick tiers and truncated crown, flanking towers have irregular heavily eroded brick tops; match relative heights, taper, overlaps and exact openings. Keep pale surviving stucco sections with eroded carved figures and floral lintels around rectangular dark doorways, real grey sandstone jambs/colonnettes, reddish weathered brick, missing decoration and contrasting conserved brickwork. Low sandstone platform with three short stairs, photographed worn guardian lions at each approach, one recumbent bull seen from behind at lower center on its small worn base facing central shrine. Preserve bull size and condition, do not add extra animals, intact horns, complete stucco coating or invented statues. Trees behind shrines, pale blue sky with thin clouds, broad quiet sandy-earth and sparse green grass foreground. Adapt3:2 original to16:9 by moderate empty sky crop and slight earth/forest extension laterally, preserve all tower tops and platform, no stretching. Retain actually visible conservation state and asymmetry; never complete ruins or invent grand temple wings. Natural daylight, warm rusty brick and grey ochre stone, nuanced greens, fine readable carving and masonry brushwork, detailed translucent watercolor layers, subtle cotton paper texture and depth, approved travel picture-book series. Not loose blurry wash, harsh black outline, photorealism or photo filter. Remove translucent logo only. No people, game characters, text, signage, watermark, logo, UI or border. Archived archaeological condition.
views.proposedMode: foreground ground only; central bull base and shrine platform excluded, subject to calibration after approval

Gentle natural dappled daylight, warm grey/pink stone and rusty brick, nuanced green foliage, fine readable stone wear and carving brushwork, translucent natural watercolor layers and subtle cotton paper texture, excellent depth. Match detailed approved travel picture-book series, not loose blurry washes, thick black outlines, photorealism or photo filter. Remove translucent watermark only.
